Figure 1. Three-residue macrocycles, 3-CyFEs SSN, and XYE BGCs.

are colored based on maturase type. The reaction and node for XncB
(this study) are bold colored black. (C) BGC of xnc and natural
product, xenorceptide.

enzyme XncB. NT = not tested, WT = Wild Type. (B) In vivo coexpression of His6-SUMO-XncA(N7F) + XncB followed by Ni-affinity purification
and trypsin digestion yielded fragment 1. The MS spectrum and EIC and MS/MS analysis of 1.
